title: Multi-party multi-category data generation method and system for longitudinal federal learning
assignee: Chongqing University of Post and Telecommunications

pse.problem: Isolation of data owned by different organizations or institutions, making it difficult to aggregate data for high-performance machine learning models while protecting data privacy.
pse.solution_function: A dual conditional generative adversarial network (DCTGAN) is constructed for vertical federated learning to expand the sample dimensions and number of samples in the training dataset, enabling multiple parties to build high-quality table training datasets that meet the needs of machine learning model training in big data application scenarios.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of a vertical federated learning training dataset, a dual conditional generative adversarial network (DCTGAN), and a multi-party loss function for the DCTGAN. The DCTGAN includes a generator that creates synthetic data and a discriminator that evaluates the quality of the generated data.
pse.solution_implementation: The system begins by establishing a vertical federated learning training dataset for generating multi-party and multi-class data model training. A dual conditional generative adversarial network is built, with a multi-party loss function designed specifically for the DCTGAN. The DCTGAN is trained through a specified process, and a multi-party multi-class data generation scheme is implemented based on the DCTGAN.
pse.effect: The system addresses the issue of inadequate training data by generating synthetic data, improving the quality and quantity of training datasets, thereby enabling high-performance machine learning models to be trained for big data application scenarios.
